findings.issue: Glossary freezes Eredrim's motto as السلام له ثمن. and notes it must be identical at every recurrence; this row rewrites it, so the Shell's motto no longer matches the same line where it appears elsewhere.

findings.source_en: A balanced two-handed sword with long reach.
findings.issue: بعيد المدى is the frozen term for the 'ranged' weapon class, so describing a two-handed melee sword with it reads as a ranged weapon on the stat card.
findings.suggested_ar: سيف بيدين متّزن ذو مدى طويل.

findings.issue: The crossbow's own ammunition is سهم النشّاب (ST_Core_Interactions/CrossbowBolt), so the weapon should be النشّاب; القوس ('bow') both loses the crossbow distinction and mismatches its ammo item.
